description: Image Description: The image shows a wheelbarrow filled with a large number of apples. The apples vary in color, with shades of red, green, and yellow, and many are covered in patches of dirt or leaves, indicating they have been freshly picked from the ground. The wheelbarrow is made of metal and is situated on a wooden surface, likely a deck or patio. In the background, there is a garden area with grass, trees, and shrubs, suggesting a rural or garden setting
